exposure: duration of second stage of labor
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at a university hospital
finding: Maternal age, parity, gestational hypertensive disorders, maternal comorbidities, lower predelivery hemoglobin level, major placental abnormalities, nonelective procedure, prolonged second stage of labor, longer duration of surgery, general anesthesia, and greater estimated operative blood loss were independently associated with blood transfusion requirement after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study examined risk factors for blood transfusion after cesarean delivery, but did not directly compare outcomes between different modes of delivery.
